comment:
* This class defines the X500Name attribute for the Certificate.
 *
 * @author Amit Kapoor
 * @author Hemma Prafullchandra
 * @see CertAttrSet

variables.name: IDENT
variables.comment:
* Identifier for this attribute, to be used with the
     * get, set, delete methods of Certificate, x509 type.

variables.name: NAME
variables.comment: * Sub attributes name for this CertAttrSet.

variables.name: DN_PRINCIPAL
variables.comment: do not allow a set() of this value, do not advertise with getElements()

variables.name: dnPrincipal
variables.comment: cached X500Principal version of the name

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment: * Return the name as user readable string.

methods.name: public void encode(OutputStream out) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Encode the name in DER form to the stream.
     *
     * @param out the DerOutputStream to marshal the contents to.
     * @exception IOException on errors.

methods.name: public void set(String name, Object obj) throws IOException
public Object get(String name) throws IOException
public void delete(String name) throws IOException
public Enumeration<String> getElements()
methods.comment:
* Return an enumeration of names of attributes existing within this
     * attribute.

methods.name: public String getName()
methods.comment: * Return the name of this attribute.

methodNames: public void encode(OutputStream out) throws IOException
public void set(String name, Object obj) throws IOException
public Object get(String name) throws IOException
public void delete(String name) throws IOException
